items.item_text: Bachelor’s Degree in a related area and/or an equivalent combination of education and experience directly related to employee relations in both union and non-union environments including supervisory experience in an organization of significant size, diversity, and complexity.
Extensive progressively responsible experience in Employee Relations, Labor Relations, Human Resources, or related field.
Experience in an academic medical center, healthcare environment, or public sector organization
Significant experience advising executive leadership and management on complex employment matters.
Experience supervising Employee Relations, Labor Relations, or Human Resources professionals.
Experience conducting or overseeing workplace investigations and corrective action processes.
Experience leading large-scale organizational initiatives or change management efforts.
Experience interpreting and applying collective bargaining agreements, personnel policies, and employment laws.
Experience partnering with legal counsel on litigation, administrative complaints, or agency responses.
Supervisory or management experience leading professional staff.
Experience managing employee relations programs within a large, complex organization.
Experience managing complex, high-risk employee relations matters involving significant organizational impact.
Experience coordinating with legal counsel and responding to litigation, administrative charges, and regulatory inquiries.

Under the general direction of the Employee Relations Director, provides operational leadership and implementation oversight for the Employee Relations function. Directly supervises Employee Relations Consultants and assigned staff, ensuring the effective delivery of employee relations services across UC Davis Health. Oversees the administration of employee relations programs and services, ensuring consistent application of University policies, collective bargaining agreements, employment laws, and organizational practices in alignment with established strategic direction.

Serves as a senior advisor and subject matter expert to executive leadership, department administrators, managers, and Human Resources partners on highly complex, sensitive, and high-risk employee relations matters. Provides strategic consultation regarding employee conduct, performance management, workplace investigations, corrective action, organizational change, conflict resolution, reductions in force, and other employment-related issues. Reviews, offers recommendations, and provides first level approval on significant employment actions, partnering with the Employee Relations Director on high-impact or high-risk matters and developing risk mitigation strategies.
Expert knowledge of employee relations principles, practices, investigations, and dispute resolution.
Knowledge of University of California policies, procedures, and collective bargaining agreements.
In-depth knowledge of applicable federal and state employment laws and regulations.
Knowledge of HEERA and public-sector labor relations.
Expert knowledge of collective bargaining agreements and labor-management principles.
Demonstrated ability to lead organization-wide projects and initiatives.
Demonstrated ability to manage highly sensitive and complex employee relations matters involving significant organizational risk.
Demonstrated ability to supervise, coach, develop, and evaluate professional staff.
Strong leadership and organizational effectiveness skills.
Superior written, verbal, presentation, and consultation skills.
Ability to influence decision-making among senior leaders and stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to lead organizational change and strategic initiatives.
Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate complex situations and develop practical solutions.
